name: Elip AI
long_description:
Elip sends you the jobs a friend would send you, and gives a company the shortlist a friend would write.

For people: add your resume and say what you want and what you'd never take. Each morning Elip reads millions of jobs from across the internet with that in mind. It sets aside what you said no to and sends the few that fit, each with why and what's missing. Some mornings, none. When one is right, Elip rewrites your resume for that role and you approve every change. Free.

For companies: tell Elip the role. Within minutes you get a short list of people who fit, each with the reason. You meet once they say yes, and pay 10% of first-year base salary only when you hire. Nobody can pay to appear on a shortlist.

Where Elip is going: a world where nobody has to start from zero with a stranger.

Elip is based in San Francisco.
one_liner: Jobs a friend would send you, and a shortlist a friend would write.
